job.title: Sales Manager
job.description:
Are you an ambitious sales leader who enjoys building teams, creating structure and turning growth plans into commercial results?

 

We’re recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing healthcare business looking for a Sales Manager to build and lead a new national outbound sales function.

 

This is a newly created role with genuine scope to shape the team from the ground up. You’ll recruit and develop Sales Representatives, introduce scalable sales processes and create a high-performance culture focused on customer acquisition, revenue growth and exceptional service.

It’s an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven, hands-on leader who wants the autonomy to create something new and make a visible impact.

 

The role

You’ll take ownership of an outbound sales function focused primarily on developing new business across the care home market, alongside supporting direct-to-patient services.

Working closely with field-based Territory Executives and wider operational teams, you’ll ensure opportunities are identified, developed and converted effectively, while delivering a seamless and compassionate experience for customers, patients and carers.

 

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Recruiting, leading and developing a high-performing outbound sales team
  • Creating the team structure, KPIs, coaching frameworks and performance standards
  • Developing and delivering sales campaigns across care home and direct-to-patient channels
  • Driving customer acquisition, conversion and revenue growth
  • Introducing effective prospecting and consultative-selling approaches
  • Building relationships with care home owners, managers and procurement teams
  • Working closely with field sales colleagues to generate qualified opportunities and maximise conversion
  • Improving CRM, telephony and sales processes to increase productivity and customer engagement
  • Monitoring pipeline health, forecasting, conversion rates and customer journeys
  • Using performance data and customer insight to identify areas for improvement and new commercial opportunities
  • Establishing reporting, governance and succession-planning frameworks to support the function’s long-term growth
  • Ensuring all activity meets the required regulatory, compliance and data-protection standards

 

About you

We’re looking for an energetic and commercially minded sales leader who can balance strategy with hands-on delivery.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Proven experience leading an outbound sales, business development or contact-centre sales team
  • Experience building, launching or transforming a sales function
  • A strong record of delivering customer acquisition and revenue targets
  • The ability to create meaningful KPIs and manage pipeline, forecasting and conversion performance
  • Excellent coaching and people-development skills
  • Strong commercial judgment and a data-led approach to decision-making
  • Experience using CRM, telephony or customer-management platforms
  • The confidence to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate across departments
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to turn new ideas into commercial results
  • A customer-focused, consultative approach, particularly when dealing with sensitive or personal circumstances

 

What’s on offer

  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunity
  • The chance to build and shape a new national sales function
  • Genuine autonomy and visibility within a growing business
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell additional days
  • Health cash plan and 24/7 GP service
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Life assurance and pension scheme
  • Paid volunteering days
  • A collaborative, energetic and values-led working environment

job.title: Conveyancing Assistant
job.description:
We’re looking for an organised and customer-focused Conveyancing Assistant to join a well-established property business in Leeds City Centre.

Ideally, you’ll have previous experience within residential conveyancing or remortgage, but this isn’t essential. We’re also keen to hear from candidates with strong administration or customer service experience who are looking to move into the property and conveyancing sector.

The role would suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, has excellent attention to detail and is confident managing multiple tasks and deadlines.

About the Company

Our client is a leading global provider of title insurance and property-related services, supporting residential and commercial property transactions across the UK and internationally.

They pride themselves on delivering an excellent service to both customers and corporate clients, while creating a supportive environment where employees can develop their skills and progress their careers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Providing excellent customer service to customers and corporate clients
  • Supporting conveyancers with the progression of residential property transactions
  • Managing electronic and paper files and ensuring records are kept accurately
  • Chasing customers, solicitors, estate agents, mortgage lenders and other third parties for information and documentation
  • Chasing outstanding funds from lenders, customers and other solicitors
  • Supporting exchanges and completions
  • Inputting and interpreting data, including redemption figures
  • Preparing, sending and checking legal documentation
  • Reviewing and inputting mortgage offer information
  • Assisting with enquiries relating to sale transactions
  • Working to deadlines, targets and agreed service levels

About You

Conveyancing or remortgage experience would be preferred, but we're also open to candidates without direct property experience.

You may have previous experience in:

  • Residential conveyancing or remortgage
  • Legal administration
  • General administration
  • Customer service
  • Financial services

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Good organisational and time-management skills
  • The ability to work to tight deadlines and targets
  • Good computer and data-inputting skills
  • A proactive and positive attitude
  • The ability to work well as part of a team while also using your own initiative
  • A genuine interest in developing within the property and conveyancing sector

What's On Offer?

  • £24,785 – £26,000 salary
  • 37.5-hour working week
  • Leeds City Centre location
  • Supportive and collaborative working environment
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Long-term career progression
  • The opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience within conveyancing
  • The chance to join a leading global organisation

Location: Leeds City Centre
Salary: £24,785 – £26,000
Hours: 37.5 hours per week
Type: Permanent

job.title: Customer Service Executive
job.description:
Customer Service Advisor

Leeds City Centre | Full-time, Permanent | Monday to Friday

Are you passionate about providing excellent customer service and enjoy working with high-quality products?

We’re working with a well-established premium brand based in Leeds City Centre, who are looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join their friendly and vibrant team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking with customers, solving problems and providing a genuinely high level of service. You’ll be joining a busy Customer Service team, dealing with customers by email and telephone, working closely with internal departments to ensure everything runs smoothly.

The Role

As Customer Service Advisor, you will:

  • Provide an excellent level of customer service in line with company standards
  • Process customer orders accurately via telephone and email
  • Respond to enquiries, resolve complaints and follow up on any issues
  • Work closely with internal teams to resolve customer queries efficiently
  • Provide customers with accurate product and service information
  • Offer advice on product suitability and recommend suitable alternatives where required
  • Set up and maintain new customer accounts, ensuring information is accurate
  • Support other teams across the business when required

About You

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced in a customer service role, ideally with around 2 years' experience
  • Confident communicating with customers over the phone and via email
  • Professional, friendly and approachable
  • Organised, reliable and able to manage a busy workload
  • Calm and patient when handling queries or complaints
  • Naturally solution-focused with a genuine desire to help customers
  • Comfortable using standard office software and IT systems
  • A good team player who can also work independently
  • Switched-on, proactive and keen to learn

Previous experience working with products or within a premium/luxury customer environment would be beneficial, but attitude, communication and customer service skills are key.

What's on Offer?

  • Attractive salary
  • 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service
  • Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
  • Leeds City Centre location
  • Bonus scheme
  • Vibrant and welcoming working environment

job.title: IFA Administrator
job.description:
IFA Administrator

Ilkley | £28,000 – £30,000 | Full-time | Hybrid

Are you an experienced IFA Administrator looking for your next opportunity within a friendly, supportive wealth management environment?

We’re working with an established financial services business based in central Ilkley that is looking to add an experienced IFA Administrator to its growing team. This is a great opportunity to join a relaxed, professional environment where you’ll be trusted to get on with your work, with no unnecessary micromanagement.

The Role

As an IFA Administrator, you’ll provide essential administrative support across new business, existing clients and the wider financial planning team.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Processing new business across a range of financial products, including fund switches
  • Supporting existing clients with enquiries and general servicing requirements
  • Preparing documentation for client meetings, including valuations and reports
  • Processing fees and invoices
  • Managing and securely maintaining client documentation through Papercloud
  • Maintaining the Intelliflo database and managing tasks
  • Working closely with advisers and the wider team to ensure a smooth and efficient client journey

About You

We’re looking for someone with previous financial services administration experience, ideally gained within an IFA practice, wealth management firm or similar financial services environment.

You’ll ideally have:

  • 1–2 years’ experience in a financial services administration role
  • Experience of new business processing and client servicing
  • Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
  • Confident communication skills and a professional approach
  • Previous experience using Intelliflo would be advantageous, although not essential
  • An interest in progressing your career and working towards relevant financial services qualifications

The Team & Culture

You’ll be joining a relatively young, close-knit team in a relaxed and friendly office environment. The culture is very much based around trust and accountability, you’ll be given the autonomy to manage your workload.

The office is based in central Ilkley, with the team working collaboratively in the office and the opportunity to work from home two days per week following successful completion of probation.

What's on Offer?

  • £28,000 – £30,000 salary
  • Monday to Friday, 9am – 5pm
  • Hybrid working – 2 days from home after probation
  • 6% employer pension contribution
  • 5x salary death in service
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Support towards financial services qualifications
  • Friendly, relaxed working environment
  • Opportunity to develop within an established wealth management business

Location: Central Ilkley
Hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm
Salary: £28,000–£30,000
Working pattern: Full-time, hybrid following probation
Start date: Ideally ASAP

If you’re an experienced financial services administrator looking for a role where you’ll be valued, trusted and given the opportunity to develop, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Property Project Manager
job.description:
The opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious sports business at a key stage of its growth. Working as part of a small, fast-paced team, you will help identify new locations and then keep each project moving from initial opportunity through to opening. 

It is a varied, hands-on role for somebody who enjoys being out on site, building strong relationships and solving problems. You will coordinate multiple workstreams, maintain momentum and make sure the right people have the information and actions they need to deliver successful venues.

What you will be doing

  • Support the search for new locations by researching opportunities, reviewing potential sites and arranging or attending viewings.
  • Build relationships with commercial agents, landlords, developers, local partners and other contacts who can introduce suitable opportunities.
  • Complete initial site assessments, gathering the practical information needed to help the leadership team evaluate feasibility and commercial potential.
  • Coordinate activity from agreed site through design, planning, fit-out and opening, keeping programmes, actions and dependencies visible.
  • Visit sites regularly to monitor progress, identify issues early and ensure contractors, consultants and suppliers remain aligned to the plan.
  • Maintain clear project trackers covering milestones, budgets, risks, decisions and outstanding actions across several live projects.
  • Work closely with architects, planning advisers, contractors, utilities providers, equipment suppliers and internal colleagues.
  • Provide concise, practical updates to the leadership team and escalate risks with solutions and recommendations.
  • Support procurement, supplier coordination, documentation and handover so each venue is ready for a smooth launch.
  • Improve project processes and templates as the business grows, bringing structure without slowing down delivery.

What we are looking for

  • Experience coordinating property, construction, fit-out, facilities or multi-site opening projects; experience in leisure, hospitality, retail or sport would be particularly relevant.
  • A highly organised approach, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep several projects progressing at once.
  • Commercial awareness and the confidence to assess opportunities, ask the right questions and challenge constructively.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with senior colleagues, landlords, agents, contractors and suppliers.
  • A practical, proactive mindset: you notice what needs doing, take ownership and follow actions through to completion.
  • Comfort working with pace, ambiguity and changing priorities in an entrepreneurial, growing business.
  • Confidence using project plans, budgets, trackers and reporting tools to create clarity and accountability.
  • A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly to current and prospective sites across the UK.

Why join?

  • Play a visible part in the expansion of one of the UK’s most exciting growth sports.
  • Join a close-knit, ambitious team where your ideas and contribution will be noticed.
  • Enjoy genuine variety across property, project delivery and commercial development.
  • Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work as new venues open.
  • Build your career as the company, its estate and the role continue to grow.

job.title: Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experienced personal tax professional looking for a role where you can take ownership of your clients while still having the support of an experienced tax team around you?

We're working with a well-established independent accountancy practice in Leeds to recruit a Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant.

We're deliberately keeping an open mind on job titles and qualifications. You might currently be working as a Personal Tax Senior, Tax Senior, Tax Adviser, Tax Accountant or Assistant Manager – or perhaps you're an experienced practice accountant whose role includes a significant amount of personal tax.

What matters most is that you have good hands-on personal tax experience gained within accountancy practice and are comfortable dealing directly with clients.

The Role

You'll take responsibility for a varied portfolio of personal tax clients, including individuals, company directors and clients of the wider accounts team.

A large part of the role is personal tax compliance. You'll manage the Self Assessment process from start to finish, obtaining information from clients, preparing accurate returns, dealing with queries and making sure deadlines are met.

You'll have support from experienced senior colleagues when you need it, while having the autonomy to manage your own clients and workload.

Depending on your existing experience, you'll also have the opportunity to become involved in trusts, estates, partnerships, Capital Gains Tax and more complex tax matters.

There is advisory work within the team too. You don't need to arrive as an advisory tax specialist – the important thing is having strong compliance foundations and the ability to recognise when a client's circumstances may require further tax advice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Managing your own portfolio of personal tax clients
  • Preparing and submitting Self Assessment tax returns
  • Taking ownership of the tax return process from start to finish
  • Liaising directly with clients and HMRC
  • Reviewing tax calculations, coding notices, statements and repayments
  • Dealing with Capital Gains Tax matters where appropriate
  • Preparing trust, estate and partnership returns depending on your experience
  • Identifying potential tax issues and opportunities for further advice
  • Working alongside the Tax Manager and Tax Partners on more complex matters
  • Building strong, long-term client relationships
  • Supporting more junior members of the team where appropriate
  • Managing deadlines and your own workload effectively
  • Assisting with new client onboarding and relevant AML requirements

Experience, Skill Set and/or Qualifications

We're interested in speaking to people with solid personal tax experience gained within an accountancy practice.

You don't necessarily need to be CTA qualified and we're not looking for somebody who already knows absolutely everything.

You could be a strong Personal Tax Senior looking for your next move, an experienced Tax Adviser wanting more responsibility, an Assistant Manager who still enjoys hands-on client work, or a practice accountant whose experience has included significant responsibility for personal tax.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Several years' personal tax experience within accountancy practice
  • Good practical knowledge of Self Assessment and personal tax compliance
  • Experience managing your own clients or taking significant responsibility for a portfolio
  • Confidence communicating directly with clients
  • The ability to organise your workload and work to tax deadlines
  • A proactive and professional approach

Experience of trusts, estates, partnerships, CGT or tax planning would be useful, but we don't expect every candidate to have experience across every area.

ACA, ACCA, CTA, ATT or similar qualifications would be welcomed, but relevant practical experience is equally important.

What's on offer?

  • Salary up to £50,000 depending on experience
  • One day per week working from home
  • Free on-site parking
  • Established and supportive tax team
  • Direct client responsibility and genuine autonomy
  • Opportunity to broaden your technical tax experience
  • Exposure to advisory work alongside experienced Tax Managers and Partners
  • Ongoing professional development
  • Friendly, independent practice environment

Contract Information

  • Location: Leeds, within easy reach of the city centre
  • Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

If you've built good personal tax experience in practice but aren't sure whether you tick every box, we'd still be very happy to have a conversation.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
Jo Holdsworth Recruitment are excited to be recruiting a Business Development Manager for an established Leeds-based professional services business.

 

This is a confidential opportunity within a growing organisation. You’ll take ownership of new business development, strategic partnerships and long-term client relationships across the UK.

 

The role

 

You’ll identify new commercial opportunities and build relationships with professional partners and key decision-makers.

 

You’ll create a focused sales plan, develop a strong pipeline and support the business’s wider growth strategy.

 

You’ll also represent the business at networking events and industry conferences across the UK.

 

Key responsibilities

 

  • Identify and secure new business opportunities
  • Build long-term relationships with referral partners
  • Create and deliver a clear sales strategy
  • Research market trends and competitor activity
  • Manage and report on your sales pipeline
  • Attend industry events and networking opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and operational teams
  • Support a positive client experience throughout the sales process

 

What we’re looking for

 

You’ll have proven experience across business development, sales or account management.

 

You’ll know how to build trust, open new conversations and turn relationships into commercial opportunities.

 

Experience within property, financial services or another partnership-led sector would support your application.

 

You’ll also bring

 

  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • A commercial and strategic mindset
  • Confidence managing senior stakeholder relationships
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills
  • Experience using CRM systems
  • A track record of achieving sales targets
  • The ability to work independently

 

Location and travel

 

The role is based in Leeds and requires travel across the UK. Regular access to the Leeds office would be advantageous.
